ticker_news.title: These 20 Stocks Now Make Up Half Of The S&P 500—Here's Why That's Risky
ticker_news.description: The top 20 stocks in the S&P 500 now represent 50.8% of the index's market value, up from 28% in 2015, driven by AI enthusiasm. Despite high market concentration, these companies only generate 9.1% of total earnings, raising concerns about potential market volatility.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

ticker_news.title: Supermicro Investors Need to See This $11 Billion Forecast
ticker_news.description: Super Micro Computer projected up to $11 billion in next-quarter sales and a minimum of $36 billion for fiscal 2026, signaling potential significant growth in the AI hardware market despite short-term margin pressures.
ticker_news.author: Rick Orford
